text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(It was so obvious! Of course things were
the way
they were! It makes total sense
that nobody cared
about me.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Teio was incredible out there, and so
was
Brusquement! I can't run like them,
at least not
yet.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(That's why nobody spared me a glance.
But if the
crowd saw me race like them,
then maybe...
Maybe!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Diaaa! Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hang on. Are those reporters?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now that Satono Diamond's
long-awaited debut
is happening this
year, the Satono Group's heiress
will
finally make her entrance!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What are your aspirations? Do you
already have
a goal in mind for next
year?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do. However, I'm focusing on
what is
in front of me right now...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia... She hasn't even debuted yet, but

everyone's rushing to interview her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's right before the beginning of the
Classic
Triple Crown series, and Kitasan
Black has built
up an impressive resume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a slow and steady climb, but
she's
definitely improved. I'm sure she
has a fighting
chance in the Classic
Triple Crown as she is now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll actually be able to do this
right...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I'll be able to give people
a
performance worth watching in the
Classic Triple
Crown. I realized
something recently.
choice_data_list: Wait, what do you mean by "properly"?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
There's something fundamental I'm
missing, and
it's not just strength or
speed.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm missing the glitz and glam that
attracts
people's attention.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio isn't just strong. She's also
incredibly cool,
and the way she runs
with her featherlight steps
really makes
her stand out above the rest.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia's the same. People's eyes have been
glued to
her even before she became a
racer because of
the natural brilliance
she was born with...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I don't have anything like that. I'm
plain, and
nobody expects anything of
me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So can I actually become a star in the
Classics?
Will I really manage to become
an Umamusume
that makes people
smile?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know what she means. There are always
going to
be Umamusume who are wildly
popular right from
the get-go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being a good racer doesn't necessarily
translate
into popularity, but even if
that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even... for me?
choice_data_list: I think there's a chance, though.
I think there's a chance, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as she continues to grow,
people are
bound to take notice of her,
and Kitasan Black is
already climbing up
those stairs steadily.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm not confident enough to try running
in the
Satsuki Sho or Japanese Derby
just yet, though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What we can and can't do all comes
down to
Kitasan Black's mindset. For
now, we set our
sights on the St. Lite
Kinen in the fall.
choice_data_list: Then I'll make sure we're prepared just in case.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And whether or not she decides to run in
them, I
think it'll be good to prepare for
the Satsuki Sho
and Japanese Derby at
the same time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I really do want to run in the Satsuki
Sho and
Derby... Trainer says I can do it,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh?! I-is that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do another lap, Brusquement. That one
was far
too unrefined.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've always been overconfident
during critical
moments. It's about time
you learned to control
those powerful
legs my mother helped you hone.

text_block_list.name: Brusquement
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Brusquement... Oh... She's not only
working with
her trainer, but she's
getting personalized training
from Air
Groove too...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Peers... Umas who grew up in the same

environment and understand each other
on an
intrinsic level... I don't have
anyone like that.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(The relationship I share with Dia and
Teio isn't
like that. And it's not only
those two...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(The Umamusume around me are all
friendly
enough, but it's like they're part
of a different
world...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-whoooooa!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-who are you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm Sakura Bakushin O, a class
representative!
Aha! And you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You must be Kitasan Black! I can feel it. I
can feel
your heart reaching out to me
for help!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Bakushin O? What are you
talking
about all of a sudden? Huh? I
don't...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I mean! You're not wrong. I really could
use some
help, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: How in the world could you feel that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There's no logic or reason to it! It just
came to
me, like the powerful pull of
fated destiny! It
sucked me in like a
black hole!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're looking for destiny, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! Probably?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's beyond perfect, then! You want
to know
why?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm a class representative, and
you're the
clutch captain! When it comes
to helping people,
we're practically peas
in a pod!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, when you put it like that, it
actually does
make sense...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it just? What you need is a class

representative to point you in the right
direction.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And that's where I come in! Don't you
worry about
a thing. I'm fully qualified,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you! I didn't expect anyone to
go so far
as to offer me help, but I'm
looking forward to
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good answer! Now, time to charge full
steam
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From today, we are united under the
Team
Bakushin banner!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so your next goal is the St. Lite
Kinen, and
you want to win some races
leading up to it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When push comes to shove, you just
gotta train!
C'mon, now! Bakushin,
Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay! Bakushin, Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen to this! I found someone
who'll be a
big help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tells me what happened yesterday. I
noticed
Kitasan Black's been a bit
gloomy lately, but she
may have found
exactly who she needed to
brighten up.
